The player must turn and walk ~8.4 blocks to reach it. max_distance=10 is generous enough to allow detection from a reasonable range while being tighter than the previous 16 to add meaningful navigation. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the bed.

The player starts with an empty inventory so this cannot be pre-satisfied. No tool is required — beds break instantly with bare hands.
